name: screen-069-speed
note: 069: the play-changing speed levers as a factorial against the current planner at d2, c2 and c3, paired: scoring depth of a prompt's answer inside a rollout (answers=1), powers a seat keeps through a rollout phase (powers=2), shorter rollouts (horizon=1). Adopt one only if it is within 1 SE of base at both sizes and at least 1.3 x faster. Run with --seed and --games 48.
